name: Las Tres Villas (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, yellow and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Las Tres Villas (a mountain, a tree and a house).
history: Las Tres Villas adopted its arms and flag officially on 21 June 2011; the flag is a rectangular cloth of 3:2 divided into three equal horizontal stripes, green above, yellow at the centre and blue below.

features.role: Las Tres Villas arms — mountain, tree and house
